title: GPS-WQ: polynomial workspace with square-root source exponent and wider Grover blocks

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single GPS-WQ algorithm/configuration of proof.md (finite branch n<2^32; otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n), ell=ceil(log2 n), b=ceil((1001/1000)r ell), m=ceil((n-1)/b), constant-wide profile, r_i=b_i+1 above-half combiner, Grover search, original all-modulus decoder, hard acquisition cap Qcap and high-confidence-fallback cap Cf, with NO weighted-attempt cutoff) recovers the full secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>3/4 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch including all retries, failed attempts, discarded copies and aborts, its total charged sequential work T(N,s) is O(2^((501/1000)sqrt n*log2 n)). The exact uniform bit-length envelope B(n)=2^((501/1000)sqrt n*log2 n) has growth index1/2 with an absolute outside constant. Section9 proves the literal cap/source and work inequalities for n>=2^(2^20), with capped finite-prefix absorption for all smaller lengths. All costs include source acquisition, labels, classical processing, generated circuits, decoding, initialization, reset, measurement and addressing. This holds jointly with the other resource bounds and zero-tolerance claim for this single two-cutoff configuration.

For every integer N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single GPS-WQ algorithm and complete parameter rule of proof.md (constant-wide source-budget profile of Section4.1, Grover pair search, acquisition cutoff Qcap and capped verified-extraction fallback Cf; no weighted-attempt cutoff) recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 > 3/4 from independent ideal source copies. On EVERY execution branch, including all retries, discarded copies, failed attempts and aborts, its peak allocated classical bits obey S_C(N,s) = O(n^2). The uniform bit-length envelope is B_C(n) = n^2 for n >= 2, with the explicit finite branch covering all smaller cases. Its exact growth index is 0. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N, s and outcomes, and this bound holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the zero-tolerance claim for this same algorithm/configuration.

For every integer N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single GPS-WQ algorithm and complete parameter rule of proof.md (constant-wide source-budget profile of Section4.1, Grover pair search, acquisition cutoff Qcap and capped verified-extraction fallback Cf; no weighted-attempt cutoff) recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 > 3/4 from independent ideal source copies. On EVERY execution branch, including all retries, discarded copies, failed attempts and aborts, its peak allocated qubits obey S_Q(N,s) = O(n). The uniform bit-length envelope is B_Q(n) = n for n >= 2, with the explicit finite branch covering all smaller cases. Its exact growth index is 0. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N, s and outcomes, and this bound holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the zero-tolerance claim for this same algorithm/configuration.

For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single GPS-WQ algorithm/configuration of proof.md (finite branch n<2^32; otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n), ell=ceil(log2 n), b=ceil((1001/1000)r ell), m=ceil((n-1)/b), constant-wide profile, r_i=b_i+1 above-half combiner, Grover search, original all-modulus decoder, hard acquisition cap Qcap and high-confidence-fallback cap Cf, with NO weighted-attempt cutoff) recovers the full secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>3/4 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch including all retries, failed attempts, discarded copies and aborts, its total number Q(N,s) of fresh source copies acquired, counting every rejected, failed and discarded copy is O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)). The exact uniform bit-length envelope B(n)=2^((1/2)sqrt n) has growth index1/2 with an absolute outside constant. Section9 proves the literal cap/source and work inequalities for n>=2^(2^20), with capped finite-prefix absorption for all smaller lengths. All costs include source acquisition, labels, classical processing, generated circuits, decoding, initialization, reset, measurement and addressing. This holds jointly with the other resource bounds and zero-tolerance claim for this single two-cutoff configuration.

For the same GPS-WQ algorithm and complete parameter rule in proof.md, the proved malformed-sample fractional guarantee is epsilon(n)=0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8 > 3/4 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted, and this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
